summary: Saint Louis County tower named in a 1935 CCC newsletter as still manned for fire guard duty; the Forest Fire Lookout Association lists it as gone.

facts.status_note: Listed as gone by the Forest Fire Lookout Association; no source describes what remains on the site

events.note: Two men reported still on fire guard duty at the Pequaywan Lookout Tower in a CCC newsletter item dated November 16, 1935

evidence.supports: two men still doing fire guard duty at the Pequaywan Lookout Tower
evidence.quote: still doing fire guard duty at the Pequaywan Lookout Tower

evidence.supports: the newsletter is a CCC publication, The Sullivanite
writer teases the men about getting one of the soft jobs
evidence.quote: some fellows do get the breaks when it comes to the soft jobs

evidence.supports: Forest Lookouts page titled Pequaywan Lake
page gives the county as St. Louis County
FFLA lists Pequaywan, Saint Louis County, at 47.19073 -91.87289, as gone
Pequaywan Township lies within the Cloquet Valley State Forest
evidence.quote: Pequaywan Township is located within the Cloquet Valley State Forest

sources.title: Pequaywan Township, St. Louis County, Minnesota

notes_for_editor: Brief checked: county, coordinates and gone status match the FFLA lists, so no correction. No build date, design or height appears in any source read, so none is stated. The 1935 item comes from a transcription page (centraluslookouts.weebly.com), not a scan of The Sullivanite; a scan would firm up the staffing event. Not used: a Duluth News Tribune item about a cabin fire on Pequaywan Lake, which concerns a cabin, not the tower. The Wikipedia township page also describes a current access dispute in the Cloquet Valley State Forest; it is not in the story because it is about the forest, not the site.
